entities.name: Constitutional Law
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The body of law that defines the relationship between different entities within a state — the executive, legislature, judiciary, and citizens. Constitutional law establishes fundamental rights, limits government power, and provides the framework for democratic governance.
